ntp_servers.description: List of NTP servers to use for time synchronization. Each item must include a 'hostname'. Optional fields: 'iburst' (bool, default true), 'burst' (bool, default false), 'minpoll' (int), 'maxpoll' (int), 'prefer' (bool), etc. Most systems use 'iburst' for faster initial sync.

hostname.description: FQDN or IP address of the NTP server.

iburst.description: If true, send a burst of packets when the server is unreachable (recommended for faster startup sync).

burst.description: If true, send a burst of packets even after initial synchronization.

prefer.description: If true, this server is preferred over others with similar accuracy.

allow_clients.description: List of CIDR networks allowed to query this chrony NTP server. Set to [] to allow only localhost (127.0.0.1). Common values: ['192.168.1.0/24'] for local LAN.

items.description: A CIDR network (e.g., '192.168.1.0/24') or IP address (e.g., '127.0.0.1').

max_init_stepslew.description: Maximum number of initial updates to perform step slew (instant time correction) before switching to gradual slewing. Set to 0 to disable step slewing.
